statusDetail: 58/58 atomic checks judged. The public browse journey was completed; repeated automated access later triggered an anti-bot challenge on the authentication route, so private account internals were not explored.

page.framework: server-rendered MPA with bundled client-side enhancements
page.notes: Russian automotive marketplace. Representative coverage includes national home/search, Moscow listing, vehicle detail, sign-in/sell entry, and a 404 recovery state. Not covered: authenticated seller submission, checkout/finance completion, account management, and destructive actions.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated light and dark color schemes and compared full-page screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The same homepage switches from a white surface/light controls to a black surface/dark controls under prefers-color-scheme; root computed color-scheme is dark in the dark condition.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion and inspected active animations/CSS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The reduced-motion capture remained static and document.getAnimations() returned no active animations on the four representative pages.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated forced-colors and prefers-contrast, then visually inspected the result.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The forced-colors screenshot removes the visible H1 while surrounding navigation and cards remain visible.

checkOutcomes.method: Recorded a cross-document navigation and inspected CSS for view-transition rules.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The recorded listing-to-detail navigation is an abrupt full-document replacement; CSS inspection found no authored view-transition rules.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS and active animations on listing/detail pages.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No parallax, scroll reveal, scrollytelling, or other scroll-linked motion exists on the audited templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: No parallax, scroll reveal, scrollytelling, or other scroll-linked motion exists on the audited templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected carousel controls and page interaction behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The promoted-listing rail uses native scrollable content with explicit previous/next buttons and no observed custom pointermove gesture layer.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected the long listing at initial and scrolled structure and searched CSS features.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 8,354px listing has static page chrome and no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or position-responsive navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected representative primary paths for tooltips, popovers, and menus requiring anchored placement.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip or transient edge-positioned overlay is part of the audited browse-to-detail journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip or transient edge-positioned overlay is part of the audited browse-to-detail journey.

checkOutcomes.method: Visually inspected breadcrumbs, selected tabs, card links, and 404 recovery.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Breadcrumbs, selected filter tabs, descriptive card links, and the detail-page H1 preserve orientation across the browse journey.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured first-load states on four templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage, listing, detail, and initial sign-in loads show primary content without a marketing modal, consent wall, or obscuring interstitial.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected interactive disclosure controls and DOM primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited browse flow uses native buttons, links, form controls, and a disclosure button; no custom modal or transient overlay was encountered.

checkOutcomes.method: Visually assessed content-to-chrome proportions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The primary viewport is dominated by listings, filters, vehicle imagery, price, and specifications; site chrome is one compact header.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured all templates at 360x800 and measured viewport/layout metrics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: At a 360px viewport with desktop UA, Chrome lays the page out at 1,024 CSS px and scales it to 0.3516, making text and controls extremely small instead of reflowing.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected loaded CSS for containment and container queries.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Across reusable listing cards, filters, and detail panels, CSS inspection found no @container or container-type usage; adaptation depends on whole-page/device treatment.

checkOutcomes.method: Focused interactive elements and inspected computed outline/box-shadow; reviewed Lighthouse target-size result.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse passed target size, but the focus probe found 30 sampled interactive elements with neither an outline nor box-shadow in their focused state.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first viewports and heading/action hierarchy.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage says “Дром Авто - Продажа автомобилей”, immediately exposes vehicle filters, and gives clear listing and “Подать объявление” actions.

checkOutcomes.method: Walked the public browse journey from market/listing card to a vehicle detail page.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A user can browse location-filtered listings, open a specific vehicle, and reach price, specifications, VIN information, seller content, and related inventory without a dead end.

checkOutcomes.method: Opened a guaranteed-invalid route and inspected recovery actions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 404 state names the problem, provides a prominent homepage recovery link and sitemap link, and retains global navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse mobile plus a raw DevTools trace.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 6,757ms (performance 0.68), outside the good range; CLS was 0 and TBT 102ms. The unthrottled trace measured LCP 1,269ms.

checkOutcomes.method: Observed layout shifts and reviewed image sizing.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Layout observer and Lighthouse both measured CLS 0 on the homepage; no visible first-load jump appeared in captures.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured a DevTools performance trace and layout long-task observer.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The trace reported 2 long tasks, longest 127.3ms, and 81.75ms total blocking time; Lighthouse TBT was 102ms, a bounded rather than dominant main-thread cost.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and confirmed stylesheet/script delivery against the DOM.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load transferred 944KB with no uncompressed text over 2KB, no redirect chain, and an unthrottled 1.27s LCP; five parser stylesheets are the principal blocking resources.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse code-coverage diagnostics and inspected HAR script totals.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse identified 103KB of unused JavaScript, including 99% unused in one 58KB ui bundle; HAR recorded 46 script requests totaling 564KB.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse accessibility and DOM/form/image probes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found a visible-label/accessibility-name mismatch; the DOM probe found many search controls without explicit labels, and the image audit counted 33 images without alt attributes.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse contrast audit and forced-colors screenshot review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found listing/status text ratios as low as 1.6:1 and repeated 2.17–3.4:1 failures, below WCAG minimums.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse heading/landmark audits and an active focus-style probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The document has no main landmark, skips from H1 to H3, and 30 sampled focused controls exposed neither outline nor box-shadow.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed desktop and 360px captures plus computed viewport scale.
checkOutcomes.evidence: At 360px with desktop UA the 1,024px layout is scaled to 35%, making navigation, filters, and listing metadata too small for comfortable reading.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed narrow-viewport reflow and Lighthouse target/media audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Touch targets passed Lighthouse, but the narrow desktop-UA viewport does not reflow: it scales a 1,024px page down to 360px, undermining zoom/reflow usability.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse console and exception audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console audit passed with no items.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected doctype/charset and ran image audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype and charset are valid and CLS is zero, but 51 of 74 images omit intrinsic dimensions and 57 use legacy formats.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse deprecation, BFCache, console, and browser best-practice audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reported no deprecated APIs, no BFCache failure, no console errors, and no notification/geolocation prompt on load; its generic inspector-issues audit was the only failed platform diagnostic.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected metadata on all representative templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage, listing, and detail pages expose descriptive, route-specific titles and the homepage has a specific meta description.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected anchor hrefs, viewport metadata, robots.txt, and Lighthouse SEO.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Links use real href values, viewport metadata exists, robots allows public listing/detail routes, and Lighthouse SEO scored 1.0.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked response state, canonical link, robots, and declared sitemap indexes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Public pages return 200, the homepage canonical is https://auto.drom.ru/, no accidental noindex was observed, and robots.txt declares generated sitemap indexes.

checkOutcomes.method: Parsed social tags and JSON-LD scripts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage includes Open Graph title/description/image/url/type, Twitter card metadata, and 23 JSON-LD blocks aligned with the marketplace content.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran headers, cookies, secrets, and HAR primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS is used and no sensitive client secret was found, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent; all 8 observed cookies lack Secure and report SameSite=None.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and tracker inventory and examined background analytics requests.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page contacts 7 non-origin hosts and emits pageview, visibility-change, viewport, theme, and component-view telemetry automatically; no known third-party tracker signature was detected.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected initial sign-in UI and searched the rendered sign-in surface for WebAuthn/passkey support.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial sign-in page offers password and Telegram login only; no passkey/WebAuthn affordance was visible. No browser permission prompt fired on page load.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected main-document security and privacy headers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No HSTS, clickjacking defense, CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy is sent.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared raw server HTML with rendered DOM and JS-disabled crawler screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site is server-rendered rather than a JS shell; browser and crawler views both retain navigation, H1, vehicle cards, prices, and core browse links, with 55–65% rendered-word coverage.

checkOutcomes.method: Exercised the public browse route and inspected control/runtime state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Server-rendered navigation and native links remain stable across home, listing, detail, and 404 states; no cut-off menu or broken asynchronous shell appeared in the representative journey.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked manifest and service-worker state and judged site intent.
checkOutcomes.evidence: This inventory marketplace depends on live vehicle availability and seller data; installability/offline transaction support is not a reasonable requirement for the audited public browse surface.
checkOutcomes.reason: This inventory marketplace depends on live vehicle availability and seller data; installability/offline transaction support is not a reasonable requirement for the audited public browse surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Opened an invalid route and inspected recovery content.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The custom 404 clearly explains the missing page and offers direct homepage and sitemap recovery links instead of a blank shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected lang/dir and loaded CSS property usage.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The correct lang="ru" is present, but dir is unset and CSS inspection counted 102 physical left/right properties versus zero logical inline/block properties on the listing template.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed visible data types across listing and detail templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited Russian-only surfaces show vehicle model years and ruble prices but no locale-switching, calendar, duration, or user-entered locale-sensitive data flow to test.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited Russian-only surfaces show vehicle model years and ruble prices but no locale-switching, calendar, duration, or user-entered locale-sensitive data flow to test.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed visible content and forms for scheduled/date-time concepts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No events, appointments, recurring intervals, deadlines, or time-zone-sensitive timestamps occur in the audited marketplace journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: No events, appointments, recurring intervals, deadlines, or time-zone-sensitive timestamps occur in the audited marketplace journey.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed browse, listing, detail, sign-in, and recovery surfaces.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Pricing, vehicle condition, seller content, and sign-in choices are presented directly; no confirmshaming, disguised advertising control, preselected continuity, or consent nag was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected sign-in labels/recovery and the 404 error path.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial sign-in screen uses visible labels and provides “restore access”; the 404 explains the failure and gives recovery links. No blaming or premature inline error was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected the public search filters and initial sign-in form presentation.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search inputs expose task-specific visible prompts, and the sign-in form visibly identifies phone/login and password with an access-recovery route; no paste prevention was observed by Lighthouse.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed visible pricing, seller/detail information, and initial authentication choices.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Vehicle price and finance terms are prominent on the detail page, and sign-in presents password and Telegram methods plus terms/privacy links without a preselected paid commitment.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran image inventory and HAR transfer analysis.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Of 74 images, 57 use legacy formats, 19 are oversized, 51 lack intrinsic dimensions, and only one uses srcset.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected background requests and trace activity after load.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page automatically sends multiple component-view, visibility, theme, viewport, and page-interaction telemetry requests; 46 script requests are loaded for the initial marketplace view.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured transfer weight by resource type and checked autoplay media.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial load is under 1MB transferred, has no video/audio or autoplay media, and most non-origin bytes are Drom-owned static assets rather than embedded media platforms.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered/source capabilities and judged emerging feature applicability.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No WebMCP or agent-tool surface is declared, and this emerging capability was not stated as an intent for the public classifieds site; absence is treated as an opportunity, not a defect.
checkOutcomes.reason: No WebMCP or agent-tool surface is declared, and this emerging capability was not stated as an intent for the public classifieds site; absence is treated as an opportunity, not a defect.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected page scripts/features and judged use-case applicability.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited browse/search experience has no summarisation or generative task where built-in on-device inference is necessary.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited browse/search experience has no summarisation or generative task where built-in on-device inference is necessary.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared baseline and post-interaction heap summaries after repeating an open/close-style button interaction ten times.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Heap self size rose 22.25MB to 22.68MB (1.9%) and DOM nodes rose 2,122 to 2,139; this bounded delta does not show unbounded retained growth in the sampled interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed heap totals and runtime DOM/heap metrics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage retained 22.25MB self size across 363,468 heap nodes and used about 12.8MB JS heap before interaction, proportionate to a media-rich listing page.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared heap constructor summaries and DOM count before/after repetition.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Neither heap summary reports a Detached* constructor among retained populations, and the DOM count changed by only 17 nodes after ten repetitions; no growing detached-node signal was observed.

principleOutcomes.reason: No WebMCP or agent-tool surface is declared, and this emerging capability was not stated as an intent for the public classifieds site; absence is treated as an opportunity, not a defect. The audited browse/search experience has no summarisation or generative task where built-in on-device inference is necessary.

paths.description: National marketplace homepage, promoted inventory, primary filter form, theme/preferences, performance and global policy surface.
Moscow regional listing archetype and long results journey.
Vehicle detail archetype with gallery, price, specifications, VIN, seller content and related inventory.
Sell/sign-in entry and authentication method surface. Authenticated listing creation was not covered because it requires an account and later automated requests triggered anti-bot verification.

findings.summary: Forced-colors mode hides the primary page heading.
findings.evidence: The forced-colors screenshot shows a blank region where “Дром Авто - Продажа автомобилей” appears in normal light/dark captures.
findings.suggestedFix: Use system colors or a forced-colors override for the H1 and test the complete page under forced-colors: active.

findings.evidence: The navigation video records a hard full-page replacement and the CSS probe found no authored view-transition rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values for shared header/content where browser support matches policy, with ordinary navigation as fallback.

findings.summary: The long listing offers no position-aware navigation aid.
findings.evidence: The listing is 8,354px tall, while CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or progress/back-to-top affordance in the tested view.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a position-aware back-to-top/filter affordance using scroll-state/container-query techniques or an IntersectionObserver fallback.

findings.summary: Narrow desktop-UA viewports receive a scaled desktop layout rather than responsive reflow.
findings.evidence: At 360x800, layout metrics report a 1,024px layout viewport scaled to 0.3516; the screenshot shows tiny navigation, filters, and listing text.
findings.suggestedFix: Drive layout from viewport/container size rather than UA/device class, using intrinsic flex/grid tracks and genuine 360px reflow with readable text and controls.

findings.summary: Reusable cards and filters have no component-level responsive rules.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection across home, listing, and detail templates found no @container or container-type declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/filter wrappers inline-size containment and use @container rules for compact/wide compositions, retaining media-query fallbacks where needed.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not reliably visible.
findings.evidence: The active focus probe found 30 sampled interactive elements with neither outline nor box-shadow while focused.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible outline with offset to every link, button, input, and custom widget; never remove the UA outline without a replacement.

findings.summary: Mobile lab LCP is well outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 6,757ms LCP and a 0.68 performance score, although the unthrottled trace measured 1,269ms and CLS remained 0.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the mobile LCP element, make it preload-scanner discoverable, prioritize it with fetchpriority where appropriate, and defer competing scripts/styles.

findings.summary: The initial page ships avoidable JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 103KB unused JavaScript, including one ui bundle 99% unused; HAR records 46 script requests and 564KB transferred JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Split the shared UI bundle by route/component, tree-shake unreachable modules, and dynamically import interaction code only when the relevant control is used.

findings.summary: Some controls and images lack robust accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found a visible-label/accessibility-name mismatch; probes found search controls without explicit labels and 33 images without alt attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate persistent labels with every filter, align aria-label text with visible labels, and give informative images useful alt text while marking decorative images alt="".

findings.summary: Listing status and secondary text fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports ratios from 1.6:1 to 3.4:1 for status chips, secondary counts, and links, below the 4.5:1 normal-text requirement.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust text/background tokens to at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for essential UI boundaries in both themes.

findings.summary: The page lacks a main landmark and has a skipped heading level.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no main landmark and an H1-to-H3 heading jump on listing cards.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in <main>, add a skip link, and introduce an H2 list-section heading before vehicle-card H3 headings.

findings.summary: Image delivery misses responsive and modern-format opportunities.
findings.evidence: Image audit: 74 total, 57 legacy-format, 19 oversized, 51 without intrinsic dimensions, one with srcset, and two below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP <picture> sources, add srcset/sizes and intrinsic dimensions, and lazy-load below-fold imagery while keeping the LCP image eager/high priority.

findings.summary: Baseline browser security defenses and cookie flags are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; all 8 observed cookies lacked Secure and reported SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Stage CSP in report-only mode, then enforce it; add HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, strict-origin-when-cross-origin, a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, and Secure/SameSite=Lax cookies.

findings.summary: The initial view emits granular telemetry before meaningful interaction.
findings.evidence: HAR includes automatic pageview, visibility-change, viewport, theme, top-menu, breadcrumbs, and component-view events across seven non-origin hosts.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit every event against a declared purpose, remove unnecessary component-view events, batch essential analytics, shorten retention, and avoid sending data before consent where required.

findings.summary: The visible sign-in surface offers no phishing-resistant passkey option.
findings.evidence: The initial sign-in screen offers password and Telegram methods only; rendered sign-in inspection found no WebAuthn/passkey affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add native WebAuthn passkey registration/authentication and conditional mediation while retaining account-recovery fallbacks.

findings.summary: Layout CSS is entirely physical-direction based.
findings.evidence: The page correctly sets lang="ru", but dir is absent and CSS inspection counts 102 physical left/right properties versus zero logical inline/block properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an explicit direction and migrate layout spacing/positioning to logical properties such as margin-inline, padding-block, and inset-inline-start.

taskList.title: Restore responsive reflow, readable sizing, and visible keyboard focus
Deploy baseline security headers and secure cookie attributes
Fix contrast, forced-colors behavior, semantics, labels, and image alternatives
Reduce mobile LCP and remove unused initial JavaScript
Adopt container queries and logical CSS properties
Add subtle position-aware navigation and cross-document transitions
